articles.summary: Lumexa Imaging (NASDAQ: LMRI), one of the nation’s largest providers of outpatient imaging services, today announced the formation of a strategic joint venture with Hospital for Special Surgery (HSS), world leader in musculoskeletal health.
articles.title: Lumexa Imaging Announces Joint Venture with Hospital for Special Surgery (HSS) to Expand Advanced Outpatient Imaging in New York
